summary: If OpenCurrentDatabase threw after Access.Application was created, the constructor exited without releasing/terminating the created COM server (leaked msaccess.exe).
fix: Capture PID immediately after CreateInstance; wrap OpenCurrentDatabase in try/catch that routes failure through the shared TeardownCom() (Quit+FinalRelease+double GC+exact-PID reaper) then rethrows. Re-capture PID after a successful open if the early attempt was empty.
